C x.di-interface-at-boundaries EX ARC-021,ARC-007 DEFAULT ;; Interface-to-implementation registration suits use-case units, repositories and adapters; concrete registration is fine for implementation-only helpers. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov012.di-explicit-first OL GOV-012,GOV-013 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit registration in small/medium projects; add scanning, keyed services, factories or decorators for an actual composition problem. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.di-lifetimes-table OL ARC-022 DEFAULT ;; Lifetimes: use-case units using repositories/commit boundary scoped; stateless helpers transient/concrete; immutable configuration singleton-compatible; persistence context scoped. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.di-scope-per-operation OL ARC-022 MUST ;; A singleton or hosted service needing scoped work creates a scope per operation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-scoped-orchestration EX ARC-022,ARC-006 MUST ;; Within that scope resolve a scoped orchestration service, not implementation internals. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc022.di-no-singleton-scoped OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Never register a service that depends on scoped repositories as a singleton. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-keyed-when EX ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Keyed services for several implementations selected by a known key; prefer a single registration or simple factory when clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep001.di-no-scrutor-for-one OL DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Decorators via Scrutor only when it is already present; do not add Scrutor for one decoration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.di-scan-boilerplate OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Convention scanning only when registration volume creates real boilerplate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-scan-owning-assembly EX ARC-023 MUST ;; Scan the assembly that owns the services, not just the entry-point assembly. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.di-factory-unknown-throws EX RUN-022,SEC-014 DEFAULT ;; Factory delegates for runtime selection throw for unknown configuration values. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C run012.perf-steps OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance-motivated changes: identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, simplest optimization, keep/add tests, benchmark/profile non-obvious optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.dw-deprecation OL API-022 MUST ;; Deprecating an externally consumed API version: mark in metadata, document the replacement, communicate a realistic timeline, keep it working for the promised period; never remove without considering the support contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.dw-ci-truth OL WF-017 MUST ;; Keep CI definitions in source control, reproduce supported build/test commands and never hide failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.dw-ci-scripts OL WF-018 MUST ;; In CI run only frontend scripts the manifest declares; use the lockfile-based clean install when a maintained lockfile exists; never invent scripts or reflexively replace lockfile installs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.dw-no-startup-migrations OL WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Never apply production migrations automatically from normal application startup; production migration is an explicit deployment operation with approved credentials (stated without a 'by default' qualifier). ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst004.dw-no-dev-seed-prod OL PST-004,WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Development seeding never runs in Production. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.dw-review OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial feature work or a new application run code-review (or the code-reviewer agent) before final verification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.dw-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Before declaring implementation complete run verify at the scope and risk of the change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-output EX WF-009 MUST ;; Summarize what changed, Delegated decisions taken and the verify report. ;; = ;; none ;; Report fields not in the oracle.

C gov013.dk-only-used OL GOV-013 MUST ;; Add only infrastructure the project uses to Compose. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dk-env-ignored OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local passwords in an ignored .env or similar. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-health-probes EX API-019 PREFER ;; Expose liveness/readiness through health checks, prefer orchestrator HTTP probes, verify in-container probe commands exist or add an explicit probe mechanism weighing image size. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-frontend-static EX DEP-018 DEFAULT ;; Build static frontend assets in a Node stage and serve them with the selected hosting strategy (no mandatory web server); keep API base URLs compatible. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX DEP-019 MUST_NOT ;; Do not exclude files restore/build needs or tests the image build intentionally runs. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-image-optimization EX RUN-008,DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Start with standard images; Alpine/chiseled/trimming/Native AOT only when justified and verified (globalization, native dependencies, reflection, diagnostics). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-verify EX SEC-001,WF-006 MUST ;; Verify container changes: build the image, startup, port, configuration, non-root behaviour, health-probe integration, no secrets or stray files in the image. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep019.dk-anti-list OL DEP-019,SEC-001,GOV-013,WF-019,ARC-002 AVOID ;; Avoid SDK runtime images, root execution without reason, baked-in secrets, arbitrary Compose services, automatic production migrations and Docker concerns in use-case/domain code. ;; = ;; none ;;

130 NN ;; Heading.

C gov013.test-infra-need OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not build test infrastructure the project does not need yet. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.case-tables OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; A longer explicit case table beats a shorter algorithmic test when it makes business rules visible. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-one-scenario EX TST-003 PREFER ;; Prefer one observable scenario per test; multi-step tests only when the sequence is the scenario. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst003.dt-doubles OL TST-003 MUST ;; Replace persistence contracts and external abstractions with controlled doubles; assert use-case results and meaningful side effects; call-count assertions only when contractual; do not mock every collaborator mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst006.dt-prefer-integration OL TST-006,TST-002 DEFAULT ;; When behaviour depends on ORM semantics, transactions, DI, serialization or HTTP prefer an integration test over reproducing the stack with mocks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-allow-own-mocks EX TST-003 ALLOWED ;; Do not forbid mocking project-owned abstractions when isolation helps. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit permission not in the oracle.
C tst004.dt-testing-env OL TST-004 MUST_NOT ;; Configure the Testing environment with isolated resources so tests never reach a Development or Production database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.dt-db-strategy OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Real provider when fidelity matters (Testcontainers when worth it); a lighter isolated relational database when provider specifics are irrelevant, stating the trade-off; fake repositories for true unit tests rather than in-memory providers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.dt-known-state OL TST-008,TST-004 MUST ;; Known state: recreate/reset the isolated database, transactions when they fit, seed only needed data, unique identifiers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-persistence-tests EX TST-011,TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Persistence tests target meaningful behaviour (custom mappings, filters, projections, non-trivial queries, relationships, concurrency, provider behaviour), not trivial Add/Get. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst004.dt-external OL TST-004 MUST ;; External services: fakes/mocks, stub handlers, local fake servers, sandboxes only when explicitly targeted; keep slow or flaky external tests out of the fast run. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-test-data-builders EX TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; builders/fixtures only when repeated setup hurts readability, no generic data framework for a few objects. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst010.dt-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Convert temporary probes (curl/PowerShell/REST → host integration test; manual database check → persistence test) or reuse existing coverage after confirming it exercises the behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-smoke-definition EX TST-005 DEFINITION ;; 'Smoke test' means a small set of fast basic-operation checks, not every integration test; explicit assertions suit small or important contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst011.dt-coverage-diagnostic OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Coverage percentage is diagnostic only. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.dt-no-snapshot-default OL GOV-013,DEP-001 MUST_NOT ;; Snapshot testing is not added by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst003.dt-anti-list OL TST-003,TST-004,TST-007 AVOID ;; Avoid testing private details, mocking every class, hitting production resources, shared mutable state, assertions repeating the implementation, Task.Delay timing, unneeded real-provider containers and in-memory providers claimed as relational coverage. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-no-assertion-free EX TST-003,TST-010 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests (unless 'does not throw') and keeping temporary probes as permanent tests without review. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C x.ef-entity-config EX ARC-019 PREFER ;; Keep entity configuration in IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes. ;; = ;; none ;; Mapping technique not in the oracle.
C arc002.ef-config-out-of-domain OL ARC-002 PREFER ;; Keep persistence-specific configuration out of domain entities where practical. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep009.ef-no-example-provider OL DEP-009,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Registration happens in AddInfrastructure per the commands facet; do not add a provider merely because an example shows it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.ef-internal-base OL ARC-015 ALLOWED ;; IUnitOfWork is the use-case-facing abstraction over the scoped context; an internal generic base may share helpers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc019.ef-concrete-repos OL ARC-019,ARC-013 DEFAULT ;; Use-case-specific queries stay in concrete repositories, which may use the full EF Core API. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.ef-projection OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Project in the database for read-only queries needing selected data; not mandatory when the entity is needed; avoid loading aggregates for two scalars. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-tracking EX RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Tracking queries for entities to be modified and committed; AsNoTracking() for read-only entity queries; not needed on projections. ;; = ;; none ;; Tracking technique (EXC-011 context) phrased as a directive.
C x.ef-query-shape EX RUN-006 PREFER ;; Explicit query shape (projection or Include/ThenInclude for needed graphs); consider split queries for large collection includes and verify the SQL. ;; = ;; none ;; Query-shape technique (EXC-011 context).
C run006.ef-no-lazy OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Avoid lazy loading by default (hidden queries, N+1). ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.ef-paginate-db OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Filter and page in the database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-deterministic-paging EX RUN-006 MUST ;; Paged queries are ordered deterministically. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ef-bulk-ops EX RUN-021,ARC-016 MUST_NOT ;; ExecuteUpdateAsync/ExecuteDeleteAsync bypass change tracking: do not mix them casually with tracked entities for the same rows; understand their transaction semantics. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc018.ef-transactions OL ARC-018 DEFAULT ;; Explicit transactions only when the Unit of Work rule allows (several operations/commits that must be atomic); EF transactions do not solve distributed transactions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-compiled OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; EF.CompileAsyncQuery is a measured-optimization tool, helpful only when profiling shows compilation/cache lookup is material. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.ef-raw-sql OL SEC-004 MUST ;; Raw SQL via FromSql/FromSqlInterpolated/ExecuteSql turns interpolated values into parameters. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-raw-sql-need OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Raw SQL only when LINQ cannot express the query effectively or measurement justifies it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run001.ef-perf OL RUN-001,RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Start with clear LINQ; before optimizing inspect round trips, columns, N+1, indexes, SQL, plans, materialized volume and tracking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-interceptors EX ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Use interceptors for infrastructure cross-cutting behaviour such as auditing; never hide business behaviour in them. ;; = ;; none ;; Interceptor technique (EXC-011 context) phrased as a restriction.
C x.ef-seeder-placement EX PST-003 DEFAULT ;; Place the Development seeder under Persistence/Seeding/ in the implementation project. ;; = ;; none ;; Placement convention not in the oracle.
C pst007.ef-match-model OL PST-007 MUST ;; Seed entities and states match the current model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-ask-dataset EX GOV-004,PST-001 MUST ;; When the required seed graph is complex ask for the desired dataset instead of inventing a large generic one. ;; = ;; Complex graph. ;; Not in the oracle.

34 EX [x.git-merge-convention]
36 NN ;; Heading.
38 MX [wf003.git-pr-verify,x.git-pr-description,wf009.git-no-false-claims] ;; Running verify before a PR (WF-003) and not claiming unrun checks (WF-009) are oracle-linked; focused PR and description fields are added.
40 NN ;; Heading.
42 EX [x.git-report-state]

C gov019.never-discard OL GOV-019 MUST_NOT ;; Never discard, overwrite, reset, clean, stash away or otherwise destroy user work to make a Git operation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov020.inspect-minimal OL GOV-020 MUST ;; Before repository-changing operations inspect status/diff/staged diff/branch/upstream and use the minimum operation; never silently clean unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C u.git-destructive-approved-workflow LU GOV-015 ALLOWED ;; High-risk operations (reset --hard, clean, force push, force-with-lease, branch deletion, rebasing shared history) run only when explicitly requested or required by an approved workflow. ;; = ;; Explicit request or approved workflow. ;; Open question: GOV-015 permits repository-changing Git operations only when explicitly requested; whether 'required by an approved workflow' widens that condition or only describes an explicitly requested workflow cannot be decided from the text.
C gov020.destructive-inspect OL GOV-020,GOV-019 MUST ;; Run high-risk operations only after inspecting what will be lost or rewritten. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-protected-branches EX GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Treat main, master and other protected or shared branches as non-rewritable. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf022.staged-scope OL WF-022 MUST ;; Before committing inspect the staged diff and include only the requested logical change; never stage unrelated modified files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-logical-commits EX WF-022 PREFER ;; One logical change per commit with its protecting tests; no artificial micro-commits or bundled unrelated fixes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.git-commit-convention EX WF-022 DEFAULT ;; Follow the repository commit-message convention, otherwise Conventional Commits; use the body for motivation/constraints/migration notes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.git-branch-naming EX GOV-016 DEFAULT ;; Follow an existing branch-naming convention, otherwise conventional prefixes; do not rename an existing user branch to fit. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov016.worktrees OL GOV-016 MUST_NOT ;; One branch is never checked out in several normal worktrees; keep each worktree focused on its branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov019.worktree-removal OL GOV-019 MUST_NOT ;; Before removing a worktree confirm its changes are preserved; never remove one holding uncommitted user work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-push-checks EX GOV-020 MUST ;; Before pushing confirm the branch, understand working/staged state, ensure verification completed, avoid pushing unrelated commits. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C api019.hc-liveness-no-deps OL API-019 DEFAULT ;; Liveness ('alive enough that a restart is not needed') is an endpoint that runs no dependency checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-readiness-tags EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Tag the checks that matter for readiness and map the readiness endpoint by tag. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api019.hc-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Include only dependencies required for meaningful readiness; keep readiness unhealthy until required asynchronous startup completes; never misuse liveness for that. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.hc-db-light OL API-018 MUST ;; A database health check is a lightweight connectivity check. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-framework-integration EX API-018 PREFER ;; Use provider/framework health-check integrations where suitable. ;; = ;; Where suitable. ;; Not in the oracle.
C api019.hc-no-cascades OL API-019 AVOID ;; Check external services only when their availability defines readiness; avoid readiness cascades; prefer lightweight capability checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-status-mapping EX API-019 MUST_NOT ;; Health endpoints return success/non-success per probe policy (ResultStatusCodes); do not reuse business API status semantics mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api020.hc-small-protected OL API-020 MUST ;; Keep probe responses small; detailed diagnostics behind network or authorization controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-exposure EX API-020 DEFAULT ;; Choose probe exposure by deployment topology (private network, management port, host restrictions, supported authorization); prefer orchestrator HTTP probes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api018.hc-no-long-timeouts OL API-018 AVOID ;; Probes avoid long external timeouts and large allocations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-no-error-logs EX RUN-013 AVOID ;; Avoid Error-level logs for every normal failed probe. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hc-testing EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; When deployment relies on health configuration test liveness, readiness against required dependencies, no sensitive leaks and optional dependency behaviour; skip tests of uncustomized framework behaviour. ;; = ;; Deployment relies on it. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hc-no-grading EX API-018 AVOID ;; Do not use health checks as a quality grading system. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api018.hc-anti-list OL API-018,API-019,API-020 AVOID ;; Avoid writes or business transactions in probes, every dependency on liveness, expensive queries, secrets/stack traces in payloads and unjustified remote dependency chains. ;; = ;; none ;;
